Asgitta – The Signature of Modern Luxury Serif Typeface

Elevate your next project to the pinnacles of sophistication with Asgitta, a meticulously crafted modern luxury serif typeface. Designed for impact, Asgitta balance classic serif strength with daring, contemporary forms and intricate ligatures that deliver a unique visual statement. This isn’t just a font, it’s a confident voice for your most premium designs.

Perfect for :
– Logotypes & Visual Identities
– High End Branding & Packaging
– Elegant Poster & Advertising
– Modern Mockup & Art Direction
– Editorial Layout & Book Covers
– Wedding Invitation & Stationery
